notes: Read-only Tier-1 capture on a healthy running versionchooser. CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--match versionchooser/main.py, 60 samples, label running_baseline; PID 963, comm python3 secondary venv). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on read-only GETs (--repeats 40). NO mutating/destructive routes exercised: POST /version/current (switch+restart), POST /version/pull, DELETE /version/delete, POST /bootstrap/current, POST /docker/login could brick/downgrade BlueOS or execute untrusted images; those journey outcomes remain Unknown. GET /version/available/{repo}/{image} not probed (remote registry call, needs internet, variable). Raw evidence: /tmp/vc_sample.json, /tmp/vc_slo.json.

route_inventory.note: Read-only GETs probed; version-switching, pull, delete, and bootstrap routes deliberately not exercised (system-integrity hazard).

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running versionchooser (idle).

running_baseline.note: Idle service; RSS flat at ~53 MB, low steady CPU from periodic docker.sock polling.

navigator.notes: versionchooser manages the BlueOS core Docker image regardless of flight controller; platform-independent on this Pi4/Navigator host.

state_machine: none (service_definition states: Unknown; version selection is implicit in startup.json + Docker image state, not a discrete state machine)
settings_mutations: Not exercised. POST /version/current and POST /bootstrap/current persist to /root/.config/bootstrap/startup.json; docker login writes ~/.docker/config.json. Not mutated during this read-only capture.
